summary: In course IT 101 section BSIT - 1A, multiple students fell below the 70% institutional composite attainment threshold across all five course learning outcomes.

recommendations.title: Review Direct and Indirect Attainment Gaps for CLO1 through CLO5
recommendations.explanation: Examine the specific areas where students scored below the 70% threshold across all five CLOs, noting that average composite attainments for these students ranged from 60.2% to 64.0%.

recommendations.title: Monitor Section Performance and Support Interventions
recommendations.explanation: Evaluate the distribution of students failing to meet the 70% threshold across the class—ranging from 6 students in CLO5 to 12 students in CLO3—to determine appropriate academic support.

pattern: Students such as Student A consistently fell below the 70% composite threshold across multiple CLOs.
